arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ كَرِيهِ الْمُصَاحَبَةِ وَلاَ ذَمِيمِ الْمُلاَبَسَةِ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka ghayra karīhi al-muṣāḥabah walā ẓamīm al-mulābasah
english_text: Peace be upon thee, thou whose companionship is not disliked, thou whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ، وَغَسَلْتَ عَنَّا دَنَسَ الْخَطِيئاتِ.
transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka kama wafadta ʿalayna bil-barakat wa ghasaltu `annā danasa al-khaṭī'āt
english_text: Peace be upon thee, just as thou hast entered upon us with blessings and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّع بَرَماً وَلاَ مَتْرُوك صِيَامُهُ سَأَماً.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka ghayra muwaddaʿa, baraman walā matrūk ṣiyāmuhu s'aman
english_text: Peace be upon thee - Thou art not bid farewell in annoyance nor is thy fasting left in weariness!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبِ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهِ وَمَحْزُون عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ فَوْتِهِ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min maṭlūbi qabla waqtih wa maḥzūn ʿalayhi qabla fawtihi
english_text: Peace be upon thee, object of seeking before thy time, object of sorrow before thy passing!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوء صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka kam min sūʾ ṣurifa bika ʿannā
english_text: Peace be upon thee - How much evil was turned away from us through thee!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْر أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا.
transliteration: wa kam min khayrin ufiḍa bi-ka ʿalayna
english_text: How much good flowed upon us because of thee!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْـكَ وَعَلَى لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka wa ʿalā laylat al-qadr al-latī hiya khayrun min alfi shahr
english_text: Peace be upon thee and upon the Night of Decree which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!

arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ما كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالأمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā kāna ahrasanā bil-amsi ʿalayka
english_text: Peace be upon thee - How much we craved thee yesterday!

arabic_text: وَأَشَدَّ شَوْقَنَا غَدَاً إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: wa ashadda shawqana ghadan ilayka
english_text: How intensely we shall yearn for thee tomorrow!

arabic_text: أَلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ ، وَعَلَى مَاض مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ سُلِبْنَاهُ.
transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka wa ʿalā faḍlika alladhī ḥurimnāhu wa ʿalā māḍin min barakātika sulibnāhu
english_text: Peace be upon thee and upon thy bounty which has now been made unlawful to us and upon thy blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الِّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ وَوَفّقتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِينَ جَهِلَ الاَشْقِيَا وَقْتَهُُ
transliteration: allāhumma innā ahlū hādha al-shahr alladhī sharraftanā bihi wa waffaqatana bimannika lahu heena jahila al-ashqiya waqtahu
english_text: O God, we are the people of this month. Through it Thou hast ennobled us and given us success because of Thy kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.

arabic_text: وَحُرِمُوا لِشَقَائِهِم فَضْلَهُ،
transliteration: wa ḥurimū li-shaqāʾihim faḍlahu
english_text: Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

arabic_text: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا اثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ، وَهَدَيْتَنَا مِنْ سُنَّتِهِ،
transliteration: 'anta waliyyu ma athartana bihi min ma'rifatihi wahadaytanā min sunnatihi
english_text: Thou art the patron of the knowledge of it by which Thou hast preferred us, and its prescribed practices to which Thou hast guided us.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ عَلى تَقْصِير، وَأَدَّيْنَا فِيهِ قَلِيلاً مِنْ كَثِيـر.
transliteration: waqad tawallayna bi tawfiqika ṣiyāmahu wa qiyamahu ʿalā taqṣīr wa addaynā fīhi qalīlan min kathīr
english_text: We have undertaken, through Thy giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings, and we have performed little of much.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحمدُ إقْـرَاراً بِـالإسَاءَةَ وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالإضَاعَةِ، وَلَك مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ، وَمِنْ أَلْسِنَتِنَا صِدْقُ الاعْتِذَارِ،
transliteration: allāhumma falaka al-ḥamdu iq'rāran bil-issā'a waʿtirāfan bil-iḍāʿah, wa lak min qulūbinā ʿaqdu al-nadami wa min al-sinatina sidqu al-iʿtizār
english_text: O God, so to Thee belongs praise, in admission of evil doing and confession of negligence, and to Thee belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

arabic_text: فَاْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ أَجْرَاً نَسْتَدْركُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ، وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ ،
transliteration: fajurna ʿalā mā aṣābanā fīhi mina al-tafṛiṭi ajrān nastadrik bih al-faḍl al-marghūb fīh wa-naʿtaẓu bihi min anwāʿi al-ẓukhri al-maḥruṣi ʿalayhi
english_text: Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month, with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it and win the varieties of its craved stores!

arabic_text: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ، وَابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْديْنَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ،
transliteration: waʾawjib lana ʿudhraka ʿala ma qassarnā fīhi min ḥaqqika wa-ablugh bi-aʿmārinā mā bayna ʾaydīnā min shahr ramadān al-muqbil
english_text: Make incumbent upon us Thy pardon for our falling short of Thy right in this month and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!

arabic_text: فَإذَا بَلَّغْتَنَاهُ فَأَعِنَّا عَلَى تَنَاوُلِ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْعِبَادَةِ وَأَدِّنَا إلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ وَأجْرِ لنا مِنْ صَالِحِ العَمَلِ
transliteration: fa-idha ballaghtanāhu fa-aʿinnā ʿalā tanāwuli mā anta ahluhu min al-ʿibādah wa-addinā ilā al-qiyāmi bimā yastahiqquhu mina al-ṭāʿati wa ajri lana min salihi al'amal
english_text: Once Thou hast made us reach it, help us perform the worship of which Thou art worthy, cause us to undertake the obedience which Thou deservest, and grant us righteous works

arabic_text: مَا يَكون دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ.
transliteration: mā yakūnu darakan li-ḥaqqika fī ash-shahrayni min shuhūri ad-dahr
english_text: that we may fulfil Thy right in these two months of the months of time.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَم أَوْ إثْم، أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبِ وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَة عَلَى تَعَمُّد مِنَّا أو عَلى نِسيانٍ ظَلَمنا فيه أنفُسَنا أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wamā almamnā bihī fī shahrinā hādhā min lamam aw ithm aw waqʿanā fīhi min thanbi wa ikhtasabnā fīhi min khaṭīʾah ʿala taʿam mudammuna aw ʿala nisyan ḍalamna fiih anfusna aw intahakna bihi hurmatan min ghayrina faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi wa asturnā bisitrka
english_text: O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month, the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others, bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Thy covering,

arabic_text: وَاعْفُ عَنَّا بِعَفْوِكَ، وَلاَ تَنْصِبْنَا فِيهِ لاِعْيُنِ الشَّامِتِينَ، وَلاَ تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنينَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِمَا يَكُونُ حِطَّةً وَكَفَّارَةً
transliteration: waʿfu ʿannā biʿafwik wa lā tanṣibnā fīhi laiʿyuni ash-shāmiteen walā tabṣuṭ ʿalaynā fīhi alsunna alṭṭāʿinin wastaʿmilnā bimā yakūnu ḥiṭṭatan wakaffāratan
english_text: pardon us through Thy pardoning, place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that, stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers, and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate

arabic_text: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَفَضْلِكَ الَّذِي لا يَنْقُصُ.
transliteration: lima ankarta minnā fīhi bir'aftika allatī lā tanfadu wa faḍlika alladhī lā yanquṣu
english_text: whatever Thou disapprovest from us within it through Thy clemency which does not run out, and Thy bounty which does not diminish!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْبُرْ مُصِيبَتنَا بِشَهْرِنَا وَبَارِكْ فِي يَوْمِ عِيْدِنَا وَفِطْرِنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْم مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْو، وَأَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ʾajbur muṣībatanā bi-shahrinā wabārik fī yawmi ʿīdinā wa fiṭrinā waajʿalhu min khayri yawmin marr ʿalayna ajlabihi liʿafwi, waamhaahu lidhanbi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, redress our being afflicted by our month, bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking, make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Thy pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,

arabic_text: وَاغْفِرْ لَنا ما خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ.
transliteration: wa-ghfir lana ma khafiya min dhunubina wa ma alana
english_text: and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسلَخْنَا بِانْسِلاَخِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا وَأَخْرِجْنَا بُخُرُوجِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَسْعَدِ أَهْلِهِ بِهِ وَأَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسَمَاً فِيـهِ وَأَوْفَـرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْـهُ.
transliteration: allāhumma asliḵnā bi-ansilāḵi hāḏā al-shahr min khaṭāyānā wa-akhrijnā bukhūrūjihī min sayyi’ātinā wa-ajʿalna min asʿadi ahlihi bihi wa'ajzalihim qisaman feehi wa'aufarihim hazzan minhu
english_text: O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses, with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds, and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people, the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!

arabic_text: أللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى حَقّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا، وَأتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَة أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa man raʿā ḥaqqa hādhā alshshahri ḥaqqa riʿāyatih wa ḥafiḏa ḥurmatuhu ḥaqq ḥifẓihā wa qāma biḥuduudihi ḥaqq qiyāmih wa'attaqā dhunūbahū ḥaqqatuqātihā aw taqarraba ilayka biqurbah ʾawjabat riḍāka lahū waʿaṭafat raḥmatuka ʿalayh
english_text: O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed, safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to, fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to Thee with any act of nearness-seeking which makes incumbent upon him Thy good pleasure and bends toward him Thy mercy,

arabic_text: فَهَبْ لَنَا مِثْلَهُ مِنْ وُجْدِكَ وَأَعْطِنَا أَضْعَافَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ فَإنَّ فَضْلَكَ، لا يَغِيْضُ وَإنَّ خَـزَائِنَكَ لا تَنْقُصُ، بَـلْ تَفِيضُ وَإنَّ مَعَـادِنَ إحْسَانِكَ لا تَفْنَى،
transliteration: fahab lana mithlahu min wujdika wa'a'tinā 'aḍ'āfahu min faḍlika fa inna fadlaka la yaghiḍu wa inna khazā'inaka lā tanquṣu bal tafīḍu wa-inna ma'aadina ihsaanika laa tafnaa
english_text: give to us the like [of that] from Thy wealth and bestow it upon us in multiples through Thy bounty, for Thy bounty does not diminish, Thy treasuries do not decrease but overflow, the mines of Thy beneficence are not exhausted,

arabic_text: وَإنَّ عَطَاءَكَ لَلْعَطَآءُ الْمُهَنَّا،
transliteration: wa innā ʿaṭāʾaka lal-ʿaṭāʾu al-muhannā
english_text: and Thy bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ أجُورِ مَنْ صَامَهُ أَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيْهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi. wa-ktub lanā mithla ajūri man ṣāmahu aw taʿabbada lak fīhi ilā yawm al-qiyāmah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it or worshipped Thee within it until the Day of Resurrection!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا الّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عِيداً وَسُـرُوراً.
transliteration: allāhumma innā natoobu ilayka fī yawmi fiṭrinā al-ladhī jaʿaltahu lil-muʾminīna ʿīdan wa surūran
english_text: O God, we repent to Thee in our day of fast-breaking, which Thou hast appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy
